visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tabbed homepage hero; each tab switches the heading, description and CTA shown over a background photo
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width photo with white copy box over it and a full-width row of three tab buttons beneath

contentPattern.structure: tab label cell, then a content cell with optional background image, heading, description and CTA link; tab buttons render beneath the panels
contentPattern.description: Interactive tablist (role=tabpanel) switching hero copy; tabs is the interactive component, background photo and each panel's heading, text and CTA stay in the panels. Desktop 'wide' and mobile 'narrow' duplicates collapse into one panel each.
contentPattern.blockContent: Three-tab hero: tab labels 'Jackson Market Link Pro® Suite', 'Jackson Income Assurance℠ Suite', 'Performance center'; each panel has a heading, description and a 'See how it works'/'Explore income options'/'Access performance tool' CTA over a shared background photo

usage: Top-of-page hero that presents two to four product lines as switchable tabs.
reuseGuidance: Use for an above-the-fold hero with tabbed messaging. For a single message use hero-promo; for in-page tabbed content without a background photo use a plain tabs block.
